claims: Michigan won its latest NCAA men's basketball national championship on April 6, 2026.
Michigan defeated UConn 69-63 in the 2026 NCAA men's basketball national championship game.
The 2026 NCAA men's basketball national championship game was in Indianapolis.
The 2026 victory marks the second NCAA men's basketball national championship in Michigan's school history.
Michigan's previous NCAA men's basketball national championship title was in 1989.
In 1989, Michigan defeated Seton Hall 80-79 in overtime.
The 1989 NCAA men's basketball national championship for Michigan was under interim coach Steve Fisher.
Before 2026, Michigan had runner-up finishes in the NCAA men's basketball national championship game in 1965, 1976, 1992, 1993, 2013, and 2018.
